title: Secretary instance config
description: Top-level instance.yaml for a single secretary installation.

name.description: Human name of this installation, e.g. 'secretary-home'.

data_dir.description: Absolute path to the secretary-data directory on the host.

offsite.description: Offsite / restore-chain settings. The instance repo needs a private remote off the VPS.

instance_remote.description: Private git remote URL for this instance repo.

backup_pull_max_age_days.description: doctor warns if the last backup pull to an offsite machine is older than this.

age_recipient.description: Public age recipient used by secretary backup create. The private identity is not stored in the repo.

persona.description: Pointer to the installation persona. Rules live in persona/, not here.

heads.description: Model heads bound to orchestrator roles.

policies.description: Free-form installation policies rendered by reconcile.

compatibility.description: Temporary output wiring for consumers that have not moved to secretary bindings.

dispatcher_manifest_dir.description: Directory read by the legacy dispatcher for central project manifests.

host.description: Host ownership boundaries and inputs. Desired resources are derived by reconcile, not listed here.

projects_root.description: Directory on the host that holds project repos, enumerated to find repos not described here.

unit_prefix.description: systemd unit namespace secretary manages, e.g. 'secretary-'. Scopes which host units count as ours.

units.description: Deprecated doctor compatibility input; reconcile plan ignores it.

orca_repos.description: Deprecated doctor compatibility input; reconcile plan ignores it.

memory_reindex_python.description: Absolute Python executable for the offline memory-mcp rebuild.

memory_reindex_script.description: Absolute memory-mcp reindex.py path used only for offline restore rebuilds.

memory_model.description: memory-mcp embedding model for the restored index.
